item.title: Zvi Mowshowitz: Jensen Huang Resigns After Having Another Affair In Addition to the Chinese Spy
item.description: The fullest account of the week's biggest story: the second affair, the board's move to oust him, $7.5B in chips routed to China via Alice Huang's Century Litong, and why the market barely blinked.

item.title: Bruce Schneier: AI Doesn't Have to Go Rogue to Break the World
item.description: AIs are becoming hackers of every rule system, not just code — tax law, financial regulation, democratic procedure — and the genie problem means no amount of detailed prompting fixes underspecified goals.
